description: Services reporting a problem right now, the newest first: the 25 best-known, unless all is true or a limit is given.

all.description: Every service in the catalog with a problem (often around 300), not only the best-known

limit.description: How many to list, the newest first; 25 by default

name: list_outages

since.description: When the status began; null when it was so at our first check

status.description: online, issue, major_outage, critical, maintenance or unknown

text.description: What its status page says, e.g. an incident’s name

total.description: How many report a problem, of which services lists `limit`

title: List outages
